decisions.reason: The height-adjustable executive desk line builds on core office competence and benefits from post-pandemic demand for flexible, representative workplaces, so results likely meet aspirations and there is no trigger for search.

The soft sofa fits the core living range and residential demand held up through 2020-2021, but its low visibility makes it a candidate if a range review reveals a shortfall, so retention is likely but less certain.
The high standing table is close to the established offer and fits the move toward flexible office and conference settings, so a stable, hiring firm has little reason to withdraw it.

The rug collection is distant from core competences and carries higher risk, but as a declared flagship of the firm's direction, and with the floor-cushion offshoot already pruned, management will likely keep supporting it with available slack.
